job.job_description:
We are looking for an experienced Backend Developer to join our growing team. You will be responsible for building robust server-side logic, managing databases, and ensuring high performance and responsiveness of our digital solutions.

Key Responsibilities :
Backend Development: Design and implement scalable applications using Python and JavaScript (Node.js).
Database Management: Architect and optimize complex queries using SQL; manage database health and data integrity.
API Integration: Build and maintain RESTful APIs to power our AI-led research tools and client platforms.
Technical Delivery: Work within an agile environment to deliver high-quality code that meets the "customer wow" standard.

Required Skills & Competencies
Core Tech Stack: Advanced proficiency in Python, JavaScript, and SQL.
Systems Design: Strong understanding of database management systems and backend architecture.
Drive: High energy and a proactive mindset to own project modules end-to-end.
Educational & Experience Requirements
Experience: Minimum 4 years of core backend development experience.
Education: B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field from a reputed institute is mandatory.


Disclaimer: The job location mentioned in this description is based on publicly available information or company headquarters. Candidates are advised to verify the exact job location directly with the employer before applying.
